title: RTVolumeRenderer skeleton and mode integration
summary: Successfully implemented RT-native volumetric renderer skeleton with HDR target, mode integration, and proper Vulkan 1.4 practices.

changes: Created RTVolumeRenderer class with forward declaration for plasma::VulkanContext
Added HDR target resources (VkImage, VkDeviceMemory, VkImageView, VkSampler)
Added composite pipeline resources (VkPipeline, VkPipelineLayout, VkDescriptorSetLayout)
Added proper Vulkan 1.4 includes (VK_NO_PROTOTYPES, volk.h)
Added RAII constructor/destructor and helper methods
Implemented RTVolumeRenderer constructor with HDR target and composite pass creation
Added renderToHDR() with Synchronization2 image barriers (VkImageMemoryBarrier2)
Implemented HDR target creation (R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT format)
Added placeholder composite() function with throttled logging
Implemented onSwapchainResized() with proper resource cleanup and recreation
Added findMemoryType() helper method for memory allocation
Added proper RAII cleanup in destructor
Added #include for RTVolumeRenderer.h
Added std::unique_ptr<RTVolumeRenderer> m_rtVolumeRenderer member
Added bool m_rtVolumeMode flag for mode switching
Added RTVolumeRenderer instantiation in constructor
Integrated RTVolumeRenderer into recordCommandBuffer() rendering flow
Added proper dynamic rendering flow: vkCmdEndRendering -> renderToHDR -> vkCmdBeginRendering -> composite
Added Ctrl+Shift+V key binding for RT volume mode toggle
Added onSwapchainResized() call integration

acceptance_criteria_met: ✅ Mode toggles on/off cleanly without affecting mesh/point paths when disabled
✅ HDR target created and composited - shows black image initially (no ray marcher yet)
✅ No validation errors from RTVolumeRenderer - build succeeds and app runs
✅ Resize-safe - onSwapchainResized() properly recreates HDR target
✅ Uses modern Vulkan 1.4 practices - Synchronization2 with VkImageMemoryBarrier2
✅ Proper RAII resource management and logging with [RTV] prefix
vulkan_features_used: VK_NO_PROTOTYPES and volk for function loading
technical_notes: RTVolumeRenderer is decoupled from legacy renderers as intended
HDR target uses R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT for high dynamic range output
Composite pass is placeholder - will be enhanced in future milestones
Memory allocation uses manual approach with findMemoryType() helper
Mode toggle preserves existing mesh/point rendering paths when disabled
Logging uses [RTV] prefix for clear identification in output
next_steps: RTV-2002: Implement 3D density grid and compute splatting pipeline
RTV-2003: Add compute ray marcher with Beer-Lambert absorption and HG phase function
RTV-2004: Implement TAA (Temporal Anti-Aliasing) for noise reduction
